title: Two directions of honor
english: Honor directed toward the God who truly is, is surely, I suppose, itself an honor to the one who gives it. But honor directed toward the god who does not exist is, in reverse, dishonor to the one who gives it.
translator_notes: Copy-text PG 10 Khazarzar (Eis to ouden eidolon en kosmo). PD.
True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
Whole surviving scrap is one sentence; tip is the complete fragment.
orientation: The work opens with a general statement about honor given to the God who truly is versus honor given to a god who does not exist.
